1.0.0
=============
* Solution Architecture:
    * [#153290](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/153290) -- Product Attachment. Solution Architecture
* New features:
    * [#153300](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/153300) -- PRODUCT MANAGEMENT. As an admin, I want to be able to assign attachment to product on the product detail page in backend (see description)
    * [#153291](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/153291) -- FRONTEND PAGE. As a user, I want to be able to download the file from the product detail page (see description)
    * [#156961](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/156961) -- GENERAL SETTINGS. As an admin, I want to be able to specify allowed formats of the file to be uploaded (see description)
    * [#153292](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/153292) -- ATTACHMENT GRID. As an admin, I want to be able to see all uploaded files in backend (see description)
    * [#153301](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/153301) -- ATTACHMENT DETAIL. As an admin, I want to be able to manage attachment details on the attachment detail page (see description)

1.1.0
=============
* New features:
    * [#169510](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/169510) -- POSITION UPDATES. As an admin, I want to see attachments sorted by ID if "Position" value is the same for the storeview
